text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo's friends are all feeling down, 
each burdened by their own anxieties about 
racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo wants to cheer them up. So she 
decides to score a blowout win in the 
Tanabata Sho and blow away all the gloom.
